title: Company control catalog
description: Schema for company-profile/<company_id>/catalogs/<catalogSlug>.catalog.json: a company's own source of controls (an internal security policy, a customer contract's security schedule, a sector circular that no shared catalog carries) in the same group and control shape as the shared regulator catalogs (v1/catalog/regulator-catalog.schema.json). instrumentId is 'co:<company_id>:<catalogSlug>' so it can never collide with a shared instrument or with another company's catalog; it applies to its company only, alongside the shared catalogs. Controls are keyed '<instrumentId>:<control id>' in the company's soc ledger and cited as regulatoryRefs exactly like shared controls; mappings may crosswalk to shared instruments and to the same company's other catalogs, never to another company's. Write it with node .claude/scripts/catalogs/add-company-catalog.mjs

controls.title: Production access reviewed every month
controls.prose: Access to production systems shall be reviewed by the system owner every month and unused access removed within 5 working days
evidenceExpected: Monthly access review sign-off per production system

companyId.description: Company the catalog belongs to; must equal the <company_id> folder name

instrumentId.description: 'co:<companyId>:<catalogSlug>' where catalogSlug is the file's basename before .catalog.json

regulator.description: Who issued the source: a shared regulator (e.g. SEBI for a sector circular not in the shared catalogs) or one of the company's own sources from company-profile/<company_id>/regulators.json (e.g. its board, a customer)

sourceType.description: What kind of source the controls come from

version.description: Version or reference number of the source the catalog reflects

sourceUrl.description: URL of the source document, when it has one (an internal policy usually has none)

sourceRef.description: Where the source document is kept when it has no URL, e.g. 'Board-approved policy, section 7'. Never paste the document or any secret here

retrievedAt.description: When the source was read to write this catalog

groups.description: Sections of the source, each holding controls; control ids must be unique across the whole catalog
